headline: Eleven small reliability fixes — sturdier matching, captured intel actually shows up, snooze respected, plus a fresh how-it-works guide.

items.prompt_template: A small reliability pass — eleven things I tightened up. Dormancy detection now catches people whose involvement was logged in older note shapes. Intel you capture now shows up in your timeline. Snoozing something for 3 days actually waits 3 days. Common confidence thresholds are now shared (no more drift). Silent failures in scheduled-task passes get logged so you can see them in your usage report. Status changes propagate cleanly across your views. Plus a few naming and routing cleanups, and a new top-level how-it-works guide. Most changes apply automatically on the next scheduled fire — you may notice your dormancy list shift slightly tomorrow because the older inconsistency was masking some real silence.
